title: Global battery storage passes 1,200 GW
canonicalQuestion: Will global installed battery energy storage capacity exceed 1,200 gigawatts before 31 December 2028?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if cumulative installed battery storage capacity worldwide, as reported in the reference dataset's annual update, exceeds 1,200 GW by the stated date. Capacity under construction does not count.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Annual global capacity update from the reference dataset named in evidence.
edgeCases: If the annual update is delayed beyond 90 days, the prior year's figure plus audited additions is used.
Behind-the-meter installations are included only where the dataset reports them separately.
A figure exactly equal to 1,200 GW resolves NO; the question requires exceeding it.

evidence.note: Baseline series used to fit the growth band. Fabricated for demonstration.

evidence.note: Used to constrain plausible supply, not demand. Fabricated for demonstration.

title: Frontier training run crosses 10²⁷ FLOP
canonicalQuestion: Will any publicly disclosed frontier model be trained on more than 10^27 total floating-point operations before 1 July 2027?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES only if a training compute figure above 10^27 FLOP is disclosed in a model card, technical report, or regulatory filing attributable to the developer. Leaked or estimated figures do not count.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Primary developer disclosure or an official regulatory filing.
edgeCases: A disclosed range resolves on its lower bound.
Post-training compute is excluded; pre-training compute is counted.
If a developer discloses only that a threshold was 'exceeded', the question resolves YES only if the threshold exceeds 10^27.

title: More than 40 national AI safety bodies
canonicalQuestion: Will more than 40 sovereign states have established a standing national AI safety or evaluation body by 31 December 2027?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if more than 40 sovereign states have, by the stated date, a publicly identifiable standing body with a mandate covering AI safety evaluation. A body must have a budget line or published mandate to count.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Official government publications, cross-checked against a maintained public inventory.
edgeCases: Announced-but-unfunded bodies do not count.
Supranational bodies count toward no individual state.
A body that exists only as an advisory committee without evaluation staff does not count.

title: Lunar south pole sample return before 2030
canonicalQuestion: Will a commercial mission return at least 100 grams of material from the lunar south polar region to Earth before 1 January 2030?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if a commercially led mission delivers at least 100 grams of lunar material from within 10 degrees of the south pole to Earth before the stated date. 'Commercially led' means a private operator is the prime contractor and majority funder.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Mission operator's published sample catalog plus an independent laboratory's mass verification.
edgeCases: State-led missions with commercial partners do not count.
Samples returned by a lander that crashed are excluded unless a recoverable sample is documented.
Mass is measured after recovery, not at launch.

evidence.note: Schedule and funding status per mission. Fabricated for demonstration.

title: Global EV sales exceed 30 million
canonicalQuestion: Will annual global sales of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid passenger vehicles exceed 30 million units before 1 January 2030?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if full-year global sales of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid passenger vehicles exceed 30 million units for any calendar year before the stated date, as reported in the reference dataset.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Annual global vehicle sales update from the reference dataset named in evidence.
edgeCases: Commercial fleets of light trucks are excluded unless the dataset classifies them as passenger vehicles.
A restatement after the resolution window does not reopen the question.
A figure exactly equal to 30 million resolves NO.

title: CRISPR therapy approved for a common heart condition
canonicalQuestion: Will a national medicines regulator approve a CRISPR-based therapy for a condition affecting more than 1% of adults in its jurisdiction before 1 January 2029?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if a regulator grants marketing authorisation to a therapy that uses a CRISPR-derived editing mechanism for a condition with a prevalence above 1% of adults in that jurisdiction. Rare-disease indications do not count.
resolutionCriteria.authority: Published approval decision from a national medicines regulator.
edgeCases: Conditional or accelerated approvals count if marketing authorisation is granted.
A therapy withdrawn within 90 days of approval still resolves YES.
Base editing and prime editing count as CRISPR-derived for this question.

title: Mauna Loa CO₂ above 430 ppm
canonicalQuestion: Will the annual mean atmospheric CO₂ concentration at Mauna Loa exceed 430 parts per million before 1 January 2029?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if any annual mean CO₂ concentration at the Mauna Loa observatory above 430 ppm is published for a calendar year before the stated date. The first published annual mean for that year is binding.
resolutionCriteria.authority: The observatory's official annual mean series.
edgeCases: Seasonal or monthly peaks do not count; only the annual mean applies.
If observations are interrupted, the published annual mean with the observatory's own gap-filling method is used.
A restatement after the resolution window does not reopen the question.

title: A quarter of new software AI-generated
canonicalQuestion: Will more than 25% of newly produced software be primarily generated by AI systems before 1 January 2028?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if a published measurement using the declared method finds that more than 25% of newly produced software, weighted by code volume committed, was primarily generated by AI systems in any full year before the stated date.
resolutionCriteria.authority: The method and dataset declared in the record's evidence bundle.
edgeCases: AI-assisted autocomplete does not count; the threshold requires primarily generated output.
Private repositories are excluded unless the method covers them symmetrically.
If no qualifying measurement is published, the question resolves INDETERMINATE.

title: AI-assisted ballot adjudication in a national election
canonicalQuestion: Will a national election use AI-assisted adjudication of disputed ballots before 1 January 2028?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if a national electoral authority certifies an election in which an automated system materially contributed to adjudicating disputed ballots. 'Materially contributed' was not operationally defined before publication.
resolutionCriteria.authority: The certifying electoral authority's published record.
edgeCases: The original phrasing left 'materially contributed' and 'AI-assisted' undefined.
No pre-registered threshold existed for how much assistance counts.
A post-hoc definition would change the question after publication.

title: Room-temperature superconductor replication
canonicalQuestion: Will an independent laboratory replicate a room-temperature, ambient-pressure superconducting claim before 1 January 2026?

resolutionCriteria.rule: Resolves YES if at least two independent laboratories, with no shared authorship or funding with the original claimants, report reproducible zero-resistance and Meissner-effect measurements at ambient pressure and above 273 K.
edgeCases: Preprints do not count until peer reviewed.
A replication at high pressure does not count; the question requires ambient pressure.
Partial replication of only one signature does not count.
